title: The Best Prime Day Deals on Phone Accessories Won't Last After Tonight
author: Les Shu
text:
All products featured on WIRED are independently selected by our editors. However, we may receive compensation from retailers and/or from purchases of products through these links. Learn more.Phones are so good these days that there’s little reason to upgrade every year. In fact, the best Android smartphones and iPhones will last up to seven years, if not more. What needs refreshing are accessories. Amazon Prime Day is a good time to stock up on accessories to give your phone and other mobile devices a new lease on life. But don't wait: Prices go up after tonight once the sale ends.Note that from our research, prices on electronics have gone up across the board, and we aren't seeing deals as good as we have in the past (we've pointed those out wherever we can). Still, a sale is a sale, and if you need something, it's a good time to buy it. Here are some of our recommended products that are on sale right now.For more Prime Day deals, check out our coverage on the Absolute Best Prime Day Deals, Best Prime Day Headphone Deals, Best Prime Day Deals Under $50, or our Prime Day Deals Live Tracker.Updated 5:22pm ET October 7: I've added additional accessories, including cables and wallets. I've also ensured prices are accurate and deals are still live.WIRED Featured DealsOur favorite 3-in-1 stand: Belkin Wireless Charging Station for $63 ($27 off)Minimalist travel charger: Anker MagGo UFO Charging Station for $60 ($30 off)Easy-to-wear Apple Watch band: Moft Snap Duo for $32 ($8 off)Best Deals on Portable BatteriesPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerMagGo Power Bank (10K) (Qi2)$90 Amazon$90 Walmart$90 Anker$90 Best BuyWIRED's pick for the best MagSafe portable charger is on sale during Prime Day, but unfortunately, the discount has been fluctuating, and right now, it isn't the lowest we've seen. Still, it's one of Anker's newer batteries, and offers a lot that we like, including Qi2 and MagSafe support, a built-in stand, and a status display.
Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerLaptop Power Bank$135 $120 (11% off) Amazon$120 Best Buy$120 AnkerThis power bank might be overkill, but if you're looking to recharge multiple devices—including a laptop—this is our favorite option. It's not the lowest price we've seen, but it's a little lower than average, especially for a 25,000-mAh battery that supports up to 165 watts.
Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerNano Power Bank With Instacord$60 Amazon$60 AnkerA portable power bank is just one part of the solution; you still need a cable. This 10,000-mAh battery has a built-in retractable USB-C cord and can fast-charge phones and tablets up to 45 watts.
Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerNano Power Bank$30 Amazon$30 Anker$30 Best BuyThis 5,000-mAh small battery is perfect for a night on the town or if you want to keep things minimal. It has enough juice for a full charge, and it plugs directly into any USB-C device.

With a size comparable to a deck of cards, this is for those who like to pack light but need to charge multiple devices. It has a 10,000-mAh capacity, but the 20-watt charging speed is slower than some larger power banks.
Photograph: Kat MerckVideo: Kat MerckJisulifeHandheld Mini Fan$18 $16 (11% off) AmazonWhen you're vacationing somewhere hot, this fan helps you stay cool. Great for kids, it also doubles as a portable battery to keep devices juiced up when in a pinch.
Best Deals on ChargersPhotograph: Simon HillBelkin3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand$90 Amazon$80 Best Buy$110 BelkinWIRED's overall recommendation for the best 3-in-1 Apple wireless charger is also what I personally use on my nightstand. Before I snooze, I place my iPhone on the MagSafe charger, Apple Watch on the dedicated charger, and AirPods Pro on the Qi2-compatible base. It's matching its lowest price ever ($63) on Amazon this Prime Day.
Courtesy of Twelve SouthTwelve SouthHiRise 3 Deluxe$100 AmazonThe HiRise 3 is an elegant stand for charging an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods or another compatible device that supports wireless charging. You can place your phone in landscape orientation to activate StandBy mode, which turns the iPhone into a bedside clock and info display. It's not the cheapest we've seen ($5 more than the last lowest price), but Twelve South makes excellent, high-quality accessories.
Photograph: Julian ChokkattuBelkinUltraCharge 2-in-1 Foldable Magnetic Wireless Charger (Qi2 25W)$60 Amazon$60 Office Depot$60 BelkinThis charger supports only two devices, but its strength is its 25-watt Qi2 pad, which enables faster wireless charging. It's the cheapest we've seen anywhere.
Most PopularDealsThe 38 Best Last-Minute Prime Day Deals That Are Still LiveBy Louryn StrampeGearThe Roborock Qrevo 2 Pro Is One of My New Favorite Budget VacuumsBy Nena Farrell How To and AdviceTry These 3 iOS 27 Safari Settings to Get More Out of Apple’s BrowserBy Reece RogersBuying GuidesANC vs. NYC: We Put the Best Noise-Canceling Earbuds to the Ultimate TestBy Harry RabinowitzPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerMagGo UFO 3-in-1 Qi2 Charger$90 $63 (30% off) Anker$90 $70 (22% off) AmazonOur pick for the smallest travel charger, this one small accessory recharges a phone (via MagSafe), a Qi2-compatible accessory, and an Apple Watch. For minimalist travel, this charger streamlines the tech you need to bring. At $60 ($30 off), it's the lowest price on Amazon ever.
Photograph: Julian ChokkattuAppleMagSafe Charger (2 m)$49 $40 (18% off) Amazon$49 AppleMagSafe is a great feature for fast-charging an iPhone (30-watt adapter required, not included). It also works with newer Google Pixel phones with Pixelsnap.
Photograph: Simon HillAnkerMagGo 3-in-1 Charging Station (Qi2)$110 $80 (27% off) Amazon$110 $80 (27% off) AnkerAnother travel charger we recommend, this 15-watt three-in-one (iPhone or Qi2-certified phone with magnetic mounting, Qi2 accessory, and Apple Watch) has a wide base that doubles as a stand. You're getting it at its lowest price ($76) during this sale.
Photograph: Simon HillCeptics6 in 1 Worldwide Travel Adapter$19 AmazonThis is WIRED's favorite budget travel adapter. It's compatible with outlets in more than 150 countries and has four USB-C and USB-A ports for small devices. The USB ports support a total output of only 30 watts, so you'll need to plug a laptop into the AC outlet.
Best Deals on CablesPhotograph: Simon HillAnkerPrime USB-C to USB-C Cable$35 Amazon (6 feet)$35 AnkerWhen max speed is what matters, Anker's Prime USB-C to USB-C cable is our top pick. We especially like the rugged nylon exterior made from recycled plastic.
Photograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillPhotograph: Simon HillSatechiThunderbolt 5 Pro$40 AmazonThis cable is overkill for most people, but if you want one cord that works with nearly all USB devices, make it this one. It's our upgrade pick from our USB cable guide, and it's compatible with iPhone Pro models that support USB 3 to the Thunderbolt 5-enabled Mac Studio.
Photograph: Simon HillBaseusUSB-C Cable With LED Display$19 $16 (16% off) AmazonThis cable has a party trick: it displays the amount of power being sent to a device. This helps you tell whether it's fast-charging properly.
Photograph: Simon HillBaseusRetractable USB-C Cable$15 $13 (13% off) AmazonRetractable cables are fun to play with, but they're also great for keeping things tidy or for traveling light.
Best Deals on Bluetooth TrackersCourtesy of ChipoloCourtesy of ChipoloCourtesy of AmazonChipoloBluetooth Trackers$39 Amazon (Card)$29 Amazon (Pop)$39 Amazon (Loop)WIRED's overall Bluetooth tracker recommendation is not Tile or AirTag, but Chipolo. Part of a series of trackers, they work well with both Apple- and Google-powered devices. They come in a variety of sizes, like the card here that slips inside a wallet or bag. It's not a deep discount, but it's the lowest we've seen on Prime Day.
Photograph: AlamyPhotograph: James D. Morgan/Getty ImagesAppleAirTag (2nd Generation)$29 $24 (17% off) Amazon$99 $89 (10% off) AmazonWhile not part of the Prime Day sale, the Apple AirTag is often on sale. Sure, it's only $5, but that's more than what Apple ever offers (which is zero). It's the best Bluetooth tracker for Apple users. The four-pack is also on sale.
Best Deals on Cases and Other AccessoriesPhotograph: Molly HigginsUAGMetropolis Kevlar MagSafe Wallet$60 Amazon$60 WalmartOur overall recommendation for the best MagSafe wallet is this one made out of Kevlar. UAG is known for rugged tech accessories, so this is designed to be tough. It also conveniently doubles as a stand.
Photograph: Louryn StrampePhotograph: Louryn StrampeMoftSnap Invisible Phone Tripod Wallet$50 $42 (16% off) AmazonOne of our favorite wallets comes from Moft, an accessories maker known for fun and innovative designs. Besides a tripod, we like that it has Apple's Find My built in, because if you lose a wallet, it makes sense you'd want to track it.
Photograph: Brenda StolyarCourtesy of AmazonSmartishSide Hustle Wallet$35 $30 (14% off) Amazon$35 $30 (14% off) SmartishThe Side Hustle is our pick for the easiest MagSafe wallet thanks to its simple but genius design. Just push out the cards through the opening on the side, and presto, instant access.

Many people don't like carrying their phones in their bags or pockets, and this case gives them instant access. Available for the iPhone 16 to the new iPhone 18, it's our favorite crossbody phone case.
Photograph: Simon HillBackboneOne$80 Amazon (USB-C)$80 Backbone (USB-C or Lightning)$99 $64 (35% off) Walmart (USB-C)$100 Amazon (Lightning)Smartphones make great gaming consoles, but sometimes, you need old-school controls. The Backbone One, one of our favorite controllers, is on sale. Slot an Android or iPhone (USB-C) in between the grips, and you're ready to play triple-A games.
Photograph: Boutayna ChokranePhotograph: Boutayna ChokraneMoftSnap Duo Watch Band$40 AmazonApple makes pretty good bands for its watches, but our favorite silicone option is from Moft. We love how easy it is to snap onto the wrist (hence the name), and it's at its lowest price ever on Amazon.
Photograph: Louryn StrampePhotograph: Louryn StrampeSanDiskCreator Phone SSD$340 $296 (13% off) Amazon (2 TB)$215 $200 (7% off) Amazon (1 TB)$283 $225 (20% off) SanDisk (2 TB)SSD prices have skyrocketed, affecting everything from NVMe to microSD storage. But if you need an external drive to offload the photos and videos from your phone, this reliable drive is on sale for $60 off.

Another tip: You need lightning. This LED light with a mirror handles both.
